lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Beneath the dust of ancient stone,
He seeks a path he walks alone.
A spark of silver in the night,
Ignites the shadows with a golden light.
[Pre-Chorus]
The clock begins its steady beat,
Where every heart and memory meet.
[Chorus]
Rise to the rhythm of the spinning world,
Watch as the tapestry of life unfurls.
With every breath, the spirit takes flight,
Dancing through morning and chasing the night.
[Verse]
She hears the call of distant hills,
Where every secret promise fills.
She finds the key within her hand,
To unlock wonders in the shifting sand.
[Pre-Chorus]
The stars begin to align and glow,
Setting the stage for the magic to flow.
[Chorus]
Rise to the rhythm of the spinning world,
Watch as the tapestry of life unfurls.
With every breath, the spirit takes flight,
Dancing through morning and chasing the night.
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
Together they stand against the tide,
With nothing left for them to hide.
[Chorus]
Rise to the rhythm of the spinning world,
Watch as the tapestry of life unfurls.
With every breath, the spirit takes flight,
Dancing through morning and chasing the night.
[Outro]
